title: Patch: Sign in with Roblox matches Google's button, side by side on one row
thread: **Issue #3217 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3217: Patch: Sign in with Roblox matches Google's button, side by side on one row Opened by @squishy-squooby. Asked by a person in a Claude chat: make the "Continue with Roblox" button on `/login` as polished as Google's, the same size, the two side by side on one row, in Roblox's own branding with its logo. ### What it does Today `/login`'s "or" group (`apps/web/src/routes/login.tsx`, the `auth-oauth` block around `providers.map`) stacks the providers. Google is Google's own button, drawn by Google Identity Services (`auth/GoogleButton.tsx`, configured by `GIS_BUTTON` in `auth/googleIdentity.ts`: standard, outline, large, "continue_with", rectangular), with R666's styled `auth-oauth-google` button as its fallback (`GoogleMark`, `auth/auth.css`). Roblox (`custom:roblox`, R3147000) gets only the plain tavern `button-secondary`, with no logo, so it looks unfinished beside Google. 1. **Roblox's branding.** The Roblox button carries Roblox's official logo, unaltered, and Roblox's colors, as Roblox's brand guidelines ask (and Roblox's sign-in button guidance, if it publishes any). The logo is an inline SVG or a file under `apps/web/public/brand/`, taken from Roblox's own brand assets, never redrawn. Its label stays "Continue with Roblox" (translated as today). 2. **Same size as Google's.** Same height, width, corner radius, padding, logo size and spacing, text size and weight as Google's drawn button, so the two read as a matched pair. If GIS's button needs an explicit `width` in `GIS_BUTTON` for that, set it there; R666's Google fallback matches too. 3. **One row.** Google and Roblox sit side by side on the same row, centered, with an even gap. Only on a screen too narrow for both at the width GIS allows do they wrap, one above the other, each still the same size. A build that names only one provider shows it alone, centered, as today. 4. **Polish.** Hover, focus-visible and disabled (`busy`) states for Roblox to match Google's: a visible focus ring, no layout shift, works in both the light and dark themes. 5. Nothing else changes: the Roblox hint under the row (`robloxHint`), R666's PKCE flow, R2983000's GIS flow, the test ids and `data-provider` stay as they are. ### Acceptance - `login-methods.test.tsx`: with `custom:roblox` and Google both named, both buttons render inside one row container, Google first, Roblox second; with one named, it renders alone. - The Roblox button has an `` logo with `aria-hidden` (or empty `alt`) and an accessible name of "Continue with Roblox". - A Cypress or Playwright check at a desktop width: the two buttons' bounding boxes have the same top and the same height and width (within 1px), and neither overlaps the other. At a phone width they either share the row the same way or wrap with equal sizes. - Screenshots of `/login` at desktop and phone widths, light and dark, in the pull request. - New rulings get a note and tests named after them (CLAUDE.md rule 3). ### Blocked by, part of No open issue covers the sign-in screen's look today, so nothing blocks this. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_ ```
